questions: How many pupils are in each group?
faqs.answer: There is a maximum of 6 pupils in each group. Groups are assigned by ability so children work with like-minded peers and get close support from a tutor.

Fees on the Fees page start from £25.50 per session (£20.40 when paying by Tax-Free Childcare). The FAQ page lists payment by Direct Debit through GoCardless, cash, or Childcare Vouchers / Tax-Free Childcare.

questions: What is the right age to start 11+ preparation?
faqs.answer: It depends on the child. Most children start in Year 4, but many begin in Year 3 and others in Year 5 and are successful. It is never too late or too early to begin.

questions: What is the difference between grammar and private schools?
faqs.answer: A grammar school is a state secondary school with an entrance exam (the 11+) and no fees. Private schools charge fees, may offer scholarships, and set their own entrance exams with more emphasis on creative writing and long written answers.

The 11+ exam assesses eligibility for grammar school. You register your child in May of Year 5 and they sit the exam in May of Year 6. There is one GL entrance exam across West Midlands grammar schools under the West Midlands Grammar School partnership.

questions: How often should my child go to tuition?
faqs.answer: It varies from child to child, but 2 sessions per week will strengthen their depth of learning. A free initial assessment gives specific recommendations.

questions: Can you tell me if my child will pass?
faqs.answer: The tutors can never guarantee how a child will perform on the 11+. The initial assessment shows where your child currently sits compared with past pupils so specific recommendations can be made.

The bespoke curriculum prepares pupils for the GL 11+ exam, independent school exams and SATs. It covers English, Verbal Reasoning, Maths and Non-Verbal Reasoning while closely following the national curriculum for English and Maths.

questions: Where do the classes take place?
faqs.answer: Centres are in Solihull (Tudor Grange Academy, Dingle Lane, B91 3PD), Sutton Coldfield (Plantsbrook School, Upper Holland Road, B72 1RB), Harborne (Lordswood Boys' School, Hagley Rd, B17 8BJ) and Kings Heath (Woodthorpe Junior and Infant School, Greenwood Close, B14 6ET). Centres are open on weekday evenings and weekends.
The website says Smart 11+ is an Ofsted registered tuition provider and accepts Tax-Free Childcare, Childcare Vouchers and Universal Credit.
